title: Finite transport of the ordinary constant-completion comparison
statement: Let F be the supplied algebraic inverse-image data for an adjunction of finite-limit-preserving sheaf inverse images. For a commutative Noetherian ring A, ideal I and n, there exist a functor X from completed J-modules to finite J'-modules and natural isomorphisms from each finite-reduced side of ordinaryPullComparison F A I to X such that the reduced ordinary comparison followed by the target transport equals the source transport.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03EL, 093M; the ordinary coefficient argument underlying sites-cohomology.tex Tag 06YY

proof.text: Use the sectionwise adic quotient identifications and the normalized finite pullback comparison to identify the source finite reduction with the ordinary finite quotient module functor. Use the coefficient-map projection equation and the second-site quotient identification to make the analogous identification for the target. Naturality of ordinaryPullComparison and its defining insertion equation show that the reduced comparison carries the first transport to the second.

proof_origin.note: The transport/conjugacy part of the ordinary common-quotient insertion argument is isolated from the final categorical cancellation.
